description: This file defines API handlers for managing blocks within boards, including CRUD operations, duplication, and batch updates, with route registration and permission checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler struct for managing HTTP requests related to blocks within boards.

methods.name: registerBlocksRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP route handlers for block-related API endpoints.

methods.name: handleGetBlocks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve blocks from a board, with permission checks.

methods.name: handlePostBlocks
methods.description: Handles POST requests to insert or update blocks on a board, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: handleDeleteBlock
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a block from a board, with permission validation.

methods.name: handleUndeleteBlock
methods.description: Handles POST requests to undelete a previously deleted block.

methods.name: handlePatchBlock
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to partially update a specific block.

methods.name: handlePatchBlocks
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to batch update multiple blocks.

methods.name: handleDuplicateBlock
methods.description: Handles POST requests to duplicate a block, optionally as a template.
